state.user_request: r1上有自然高光、渐变色与眼部头发光泽，当前版本完全扁平；short/full没有区分度，full整体以新附完整头发和少量领口图为准；生成DeepSeek及男女管理员供审计。
observations: Actually viewed r1 and new full reference. r1 blue hair has continuous broad gradients; dark eyes have a weak dark-blue field and subtle rim rather than white catchlight dots.
Previous shader only allows solid eyes, limited linear surface contrast, no default highlight primitive; clean output lost strand hierarchy.
Current static SVG renderer already supports linear/radial gradients and clipping. Existing v1 machine tests are historical defect regression, not the new aesthetic contract.
constraints: Retain real editable SVG, transparent background, no watermark. Code encouraged, not raster tracing.
Latest user feedback overrides old flat-eye / zero-highlight defaults. Six outputs: DeepSeek and both Endministrators, each short/full.

rendering_route.instructions: Which rendering route should be used for this authorized new reference-driven trial, considering natural gloss, editable SVG and model independence?

criteria.direct_vector_fields: Write subject-specific vector geometry and explicit linear/radial material fields, broad curved light shapes and dark capsule fields. Requires careful visual drafting and per-pair review; can execute without a drawing model.
criteria.raster_trace: Generate polished raster concepts and automatically trace them to SVG. May improve immediate composition but requires a drawing model and can transfer unwanted texture/quantization.
criteria.reuse_flat_shader: Keep the prior locked geometry and flat shader. Reproducible and cheap but unable to express the user-requested natural gloss and structural profile difference.

new_validation.instructions: What validation boundary best suits the new allowed smooth gradients and differentiated profiles?

criteria.field_and_visual: Check static vector constructs, actual renders, reference-linked material variation, pixel artifacts, real geometry/visual difference and human review. More evidence and manual judgment; legal gradients remain allowed.
criteria.old_thresholds_only: Apply the prior flat-paint thresholds unchanged to every new output. Cheap but may reject reference-appropriate variation and preserve flattening.
criteria.visual_only: Only inspect rendered appearance without structural or pixel controls. Fast visual review but leaves reproducibility and noise/contamination regressions unchecked.
